checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Blue sky turned orange/golden; clearly warmer.

must.item: Same mountains, trees, clouds, lake in original positions
Reflections and surface details retain structure
must.why: Reflections look the same, just warmer.

must.item: No sun, sunset, extra clouds added
must.why: No new elements, though the strong orange sky gives a sunset feel; clouds are slightly thinner/fewer in the sky.

must.item: Framing, geometry, detail unchanged apart from colour
must.why: Framing identical; slight smoothing/sharpening and small cloud differences.

faults.what: Warm shift is strong and saturated, pushing toward a sunset look; sky lost its blue entirely and contrast increased
Small clouds near the center-left sky appear faded/slightly changed, and fine detail looks slightly smoothed

summary: The output is the same lake scene with a clearly warmer golden colour grade and no added elements, but the shift is somewhat heavy and a few small clouds look slightly altered.
